options.title: Elon Musk flies a private jet everywhere. Why isn't it his? ✈️
options.first_line: Elon Musk flies a private jet almost everywhere. So why isn't the jet his?
options.first_frame: A runway at sunset: Elon Musk's real photo head on our cartoon body walking to the steps of a white private jet, a big question mark stamping onto the jet's door.

options.title: Whose jet does Elon Musk really fly? ✈️
options.first_line: Elon Musk's private jet has a secret: on paper, it belongs to someone else.
options.first_frame: A close shot of a jet's tail fin on the runway, Elon Musk's photo head peeking from the cabin door, a paper ownership tag flapping on the tail.

options.title: Tesla pays for Elon Musk's jet. It isn't Tesla's either ✈️
options.first_line: When Elon Musk flies for Tesla, Tesla gets a bill for the jet. So who owns it?
options.first_frame: Inside Tesla's office, an invoice with the Tesla logo printing out of a machine, a white jet flying past the window behind it, Musk's photo head on the invoice.

why: It names Musk and a jet you can picture, asks one clean question (why isn't it his?) that only the video answers, while B's first line already gives away that it belongs to someone else and C's title spends the Tesla-pays twist up front.
